info.desc: "Visions Of A Life" is the second studio album by British alternative-rock band Wolf Alice. It was released on the 29th September 2017 through the label Dirty Hit. The album received acclaim from music critics and appeared on several year-end lists, as well as winning the 2018 Mercury Prize. Track listing All tracks are written by Ellie Rowsell, Joff Oddie, Theo Ellis and Joel Amey. 1. "Heavenward" 4:55 2. "Yuk Foo" 2:13 3. "Beautifully Unconventional" 2:13 4. "Don't Delete the Kisses" 4:35 5. "Planet Hunter" 3:52 6. "Sky Musings" 2:58 7. "Formidable Cool" 3:33 8. "Space & Time" 2:27 9. .

podcast.body: This album is highly eclectic, even more so than their debut. It incorporates a wide range of styles, sometimes echoing the hard and aggressive tones of Courtney Love or PJ Harvey, sometimes the classic singer-songwriter, and at other times the depressive feel of Lou Reed. Despite mixing many styles, time changes, and influences, the album achieves a truly coherent, uniform, and logical sound. "es como un mejón en muchísimos estilos hay muchísimos cambios de tiempo en las canciones hay muchísimos cambios de estilo hay muchísimas influencias y sin embargo a pesar de tener todo eso metido dentro del disco suena de una manera verdaderamente coherente es una uniforme y es un alógico."

This album was selected as the Album of the Year by Down to the Sound, a music publication known for creating quite good lists. The album is described as a very good record, considered one of the most interesting and complete albums released in the year. "es muy buen disco, a mí ha parecido en lo más interesante que ha salido este año."
